description: This file is a PHP script for handling a survey display and submission within a SuiteCRM module. It manages survey validation, retrieves survey data, displays survey questions with various input types, handles campaign tracking, and generates the survey HTML page.

methods.name: displaySurvey
methods.description: Outputs the survey form with questions, including validation and submit button, along with necessary scripts.

methods.name: getSurveyLinkTracker
methods.description: Retrieves the campaign link tracker ID from the database based on a tracker ID.

methods.name: displayClosedPage
methods.description: Displays a page indicating the survey is closed or unavailable.

methods.name: displayQuestion
methods.description: Renders individual survey questions based on their type, such as text, radio, checkbox, date, rating, matrix, etc.

methods.name: displayTextField
methods.description: Renders a textarea input for text questions.

methods.name: displayRadioField
methods.description: Displays a set of radio button options for a question.

methods.name: displayRadioButton
methods.description: Outputs a single radio button with label.

methods.name: displayMultiselectField
methods.description: Renders a multiselect checkbox group for a question.

methods.name: displayScaleField
methods.description: Displays a numeric scale (1-10) as radio buttons.

methods.name: displayRatingField
methods.description: Displays a star rating dropdown for a question.

methods.name: displayMatrixField
methods.description: Renders a matrix of radio buttons for matrix-type questions.
